widgets_values:
Global Metadata:
Genre: Industrial Heavy Metal / Nu-Metal. BPM: 140. Key: D Minor. Mood/Vibe: Cynical, Aggressive, Frustrated, Gritty. Listening Context: High-energy protest anthem. Production/Mix Textures: Distorted industrial synth textures, heavy gated reverb on drums, high-gain saturated guitar riffs, gritty low-end, occasional digital glitch artifacts and "system error" sound effects.

Vocal Details:
Vocal Type: Male (Gravelly, powerful). Vocal Style: Aggressive shouting in the chorus, cynical spoken-word/whispered delivery in the verses. Positioning: Front-and-center, dry in verses, heavily layered and distorted in the chorus. Ad-libs: Harsh grunts, "System failure!" screams, rhythmic breathing. Effects: Short slapback delay on verses, massive hall reverb on choruses.

Arrangement:
Instruments: Down-tuned 7-string electric guitars, double-kick drums, distorted analog synthesizers, industrial percussion (metal clanging).

[Intro]: Glitchy synth pulse and mechanical clicking, building into a slow, heavy guitar chug.
[Verse 1]: Bass-heavy, stripped-back drums, spoken-word delivery with eerie synth pads.
[Pre-Chorus]: Rising guitar feedback, accelerating drum build-up.
[Chorus]: Explosive wall of sound, high-gain guitars, double-kick blast beats, soaring aggressive vocals.
[Instrumental]: A technical, dissonant guitar solo mimicking a "system crash."
[Bridge]: Sudden drop in volume, minimalist industrial beat, building tension with layered whispers.
[Outro]: Final explosive chorus followed by a sudden cut to static and a "System Shutdown" tone.

[Intro]
(Digital glitching sounds)
(Heavy mechanical clanging)
(Distorted whisper: Initialize...)
Mmm... Ah...
(Feedback swells)

[Verse 1]
(Low, cynical spoken delivery)
Step one: Pull the plug, let the engine stall.
Slow it down, watch the user crawl.
(Clicking sound)
Update one: A bandage for the wound.
A hollow fix, a melody out of tune.
(Whispered: Just a patch...)
Fix the glitch, but leave the core decayed.
Another cycle in the game we played.

[Pre-Chorus]
(Guitars begin to chug faster)
Label the rot, dress it up in gold.
The oldest lie that’s ever been sold.
(Screamed: SELL IT!)

[Chorus]
(Explosive heavy metal riff)
GROUNDBREAKING! (Innovation!)
A cycle of deception!
We’re selling back the speed we stole!
Groundbreaking! (Innovation!)
A corporate hallucination!
Trading our progress for a soul-less role!
(Aggressive grunt: YEAH!)

[Instrumental]
(Dissonant, high-speed guitar solo with industrial synth stabs)
(Double-kick drum blast)

[Bridge]
(Music drops to a low, pulsing industrial beat)
(Whispered: Repeat... repeat...)
Is it a feature? Or is it a lie?
Watch the performance wither and die.
(Building volume)
Repeat indefinitely.
Repeat...
REPEAT!

[Chorus]
(Maximum intensity)
GROUNDBREAKING! (Innovation!)
A cycle of deception!
We’re selling back the speed we stole!
Groundbreaking! (Innovation!)
A corporate hallucination!
Trading our progress for a soul-less role!

[Outro]
(Heavy breakdown, slow crushing riffs)
Just selling...
(Screamed: BACK THE LOST PERFORMANCE!)
(System error beep)
(Sudden silence)
(Static hiss)
